description.text: 我们的人离开被淹没的达拉万之愚，在科乌里亚以外的地方定居，进入被无数兽人烧毁的村庄所掩盖的土地。我们在丘陵和山谷之间的土地上建立了要塞，我们的要塞既难以发现，又具有很强的防御能力。要想找到我们的土地，敌人的能力可远远超过常人。
description.text_en: Beyond Corvuria our people have settled, exiled from our lands drowned by Daravan's Folly, into lands obscured by the fires of villages burning by countless orcs. By establishing our strongholds in lands shrouded between hill and dale, our fortresses are both difficult to find and highly defensible. It will take an enemy far above the average skill to find our lands.

description.text: 在我们从科乌尔堡到远处的东坎诺的远行中，我们遇到了传说中的仙灵。就像传说中说的那样，美丽而危险，我们被仙灵诱惑进入了森林深处加入了他们。乌鸦旗手坚决执行我们的任务，无视他们的魅力，在当晚设下陷阱，以防报复。当天晚些时候，报复来了，仙灵袭击了营地。从那时起，乌鸦旗手就知道要时刻为敌人做好准备，在他们伤害你之前先伤害他们。
description.text_en: On our voyage from Arca Corvur to Escann beyond, we encountered the ever-fabled Fey. As beautiful, and dangerous, as the legends say, we were tempted by the Fey to enter the Deepwoods proper and join them. Resolute in our mission, the Raven Banner ignored their charms, and set traps that night in case of retaliation. Later that night, that retaliation came, and Fey spirits attacked the camp. From then on the Raven Banner knew to always prepare for the enemy, and hurt them before they can ever harm you.

description.text:
我们最勇敢和最高贵的士兵挥舞着巨大的战锤对抗成群的兽人。虽然他们在战斗中取得了巨大的胜利，在远离我们新家园心脏的地方收复了土地，但重型武器和装甲的时代很快随着火器使用的不断增加而结束。

这些重步兵部队的老兵组成了维恩哈姆重型旅，为后代保留了他们的战斗风格。然而，他们的主要职责是激发军队的勇气和友爱。新兵被分配与这些伟大的战士进行拳击和摔跤。虽然很少有人能超越他们，但所有人都为自己感到自豪，并感谢有机会让这些传奇人物提高自己的技能。
description.text_en:
The bravest and most noble of our soldiers swung great bludgeoning warhammers against the hordes of orcs. While they met great success in battle, reclaiming lands far from the heart of our new home, the age of heavy arms and armor soon came to an end with the ever-increasing use of firearms.

Veterans of these heavy infantry units assembled the Vernham Heavy Brigade, preserving their fighting style for future generations. However, their primary duty was to inspire courage and comradery amongst the greater army. Recruits were assigned to spar and wrestle with these great warriors. Although few could best them, all felt pride in themselves and gratitude for having the opportunity to improve their skills with these legends.

description.text:
乌鸦旗手是由科乌里亚的达万·西尔·维温二世于1441年在安全的科乌里亚科乌尔堡建立的，目的是为了击败入侵的绿潮，为科乌里亚争夺土地。但事实上，科维尔德的杰尔甘，他的同僚指挥官和他们征收的军队都是流亡者。

几个世纪以来，他们的土地被达拉万之愚流淌的流动沼泽所毁坏和淹没，这些沼泽地的贵族们对此感到沮丧，他们一直是君主的一根刺。达万二世看到了一个机会，可以通过绿潮摆脱这些讨厌的家伙。重建淹没的男爵领地对物资和资金的持续需求，以及因缺乏帮助而产生的间歇性叛乱，导致资助难以维持。

科维尔德的杰尔甘，一个古怪但有魅力的贵族，对科维尔德的废墟有着可疑的宣称，被传唤到科乌尔堡。在闭门会议之后，乌鸦旗手成立了，他们配备了武器和物资，深入到绿潮地区。国王渴望看到他们离开，以便减少赤字，但没有制定有约束力的协议，以确保乌鸦旗手对蓝宝石钥匙持有人的忠诚。
description.text_en:
The Raven Banner was established by Davan II síl Vivin of Corvuria in 1441 from the safety of Arca Corvur, to defeat the encroaching Greentide and claim lands for Corvuria. But in truth Jergan of Corveld, his fellow commanders, and their levied armies were exiles.

Frustrated by centuries of their lands ruined and drowned by the slow encroachment of Daravan's Folly, these nobles of the marshlands were a constant thorn to the monarch. Davan II saw an opportunity to be rid of this nuisance with the Greentide. The constant demands for supplies and funding to rebuild besoaked baronies, and intermittent rebellions from the lack of help, were too heavy a price to continue financing.

Jergan of Corveld, an eccentric but charismatic noble with dubious claims to the ruined city of Corveld, was summoned to Arca Corvur. Behind closed doors, the Raven Banner was established, outfitted with arms and supplies to drive deep into the Greentide. Eager to see them gone, and the deficit decrease, no binding agreements were made to ensure the loyalty of the Raven Banner to the holder of the Sapphire Key.

description.text:
我们周围都是威胁着我们生活方式的国家，他们的使命就是要夺回整个东坎诺。如果他们坚持这样认为，渡鸦边区将会见火和钢铁，并将最终获胜。

旧卡斯塔诺已经失败了，崩溃了，被烧成了灰烬。多斯塔诺曾经是他们卑微的臣民，尽管他们存在于愚地的废墟和科乌尔堡的嗜血的伪装者中，但最重要的臣民是我们。有一天我们会回来，但现在多斯塔诺将被保存在我们的壁炉中。
description.text_en:
All around us lie nations that threaten our way of life, ever on their mission to reclaim or pillage all of Escann. If they insist, the Ravenmarch will meet with fire and steel, and will stand victorious in the end.

Old Castanor has failed, crumbled, and burned into ashes. Once their lowly subject, Dostanor persists still despite the ruin of the Folly and bloodthirsty pretenders in Arca Corvur, but most of all in us. One day we will return, but for now Dostanor will be preserved in our hearths.

description.text:
在摄政王朝廷的众神中，丽雅拉为我们的国家祈福。女人和男人都是公平的，真正的爱情永远不会让人心碎。为了保存我们的祝福，丽雅拉之微笑姐妹会坚持丽雅拉的信条，甚至把她的微笑的信息传播给兽人和地精。

渡鸦边区很快就被科琳教的改革精神所感染，记得他们如何光荣地担任科琳军队的后卫。他们狂热的心固定在科琳作为弱者的捍卫者和邪恶的杀手的角色上。但对丽雅拉和死神奈拉特的古老崇拜的影响力并没有减弱，反而形成了一个三位一体信仰——生命、战争和死亡。
description.text_en:
Of all the gods of the Regent Court, Ryala of all has blessed our nation. Women and men both are fair, and true love is never heartbroken. The Sisterhood of Ryala's Smile upholds the tenets of Ryala in order to preserve our blessing, spreading the message of her smile even to beings such as orcs and goblins.

Ravenmarch was quickly swept up in the reformative spirit of the Corinite movement, remembering how they served with honor as the rear-guard of Corin's army. Their zealous hearts fixated on the role of Corin as a defender of the weak and a slayer of evil. But the old worship of Ryala and the death god Nerat did not wane in influence, and instead formed a triarchy of faith - life, war, and death.

description.text: 传说在渡鸦边区中，最好要提防窗户，因为据说有一个深色头发的女士通过窗户观察和倾听。前间谍弯着腰站在远离窗户的小酒馆里，惊恐地讲述着他们的战友们如何一个接一个地被发现毫无生命地丢弃在街上，被完全吸干了血。就连平民也讲述了他们的煽动性邻居或家人是如何被发现死亡并被吸干的故事，并在城市广场的显著位置上展示。他们说这位女士是一个古老的吸血鬼，甚至有人说渡鸦边区的政府招募了这些邪恶的生物作为间谍。
description.text_en: Legends say that in Ravenmarch, it is best to be wary of windows, for it is said that the Lady with Dusken Hair watches and listens through them. Former spies, hunched over in taverns far from any window, tell in horror how one by one their comrades were found lifelessly discarded in the streets, completely drained of blood. Even the commoners tell tales of how their seditious neighbours or family members would be found dead and drained, displayed prominently in the town square. They say that this Lady is an ancient vampire, and others go so far as to say that the government of the Ravenmarch has recruited these unholy abominations as spies.

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想快速涂图、不愿处理形成前置及长期沼泽工程的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 冒险团抢占南方据点，形成B48后建设边区与王庭，中后期处理吸血鬼政治并向多斯塔诺及更远地区推进。
player_overview.overview: 渡鸦边区并非1444年的现成王国。你先带领乌鸦旗手在东坎诺南方立足，再建立边疆国家、整治沼泽、经营三圣王庭，并在骑士传统与吸血鬼贵族的暗流间周旋。它既是向多斯塔诺扩张的复国战役，也是把一片破碎土地慢慢改造成政治中心的长篇故事。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢东坎诺冒险团、骑士复国、宫廷事件和边疆建设的玩家。
signature_features: 乌鸦旗手冒险团形成国家，有明确的前后阶段。
三圣王庭与沼泽整治让宗教政治和建设贯穿战役。
吸血鬼阶层和伪装舞会事件为骑士复国加入阴暗宫廷叙事。
player_overview.tagline: 从科武尔冒险团建起南方边区，让骑士王庭在沼泽和吸血鬼阴影中站稳。

reasons: 冒险团到王国的成长完整
王庭与沼泽治理使复国有建设面
吸血鬼宫廷事件增加叙事张力
warnings: 需要完成东坎诺建国前置
宫廷事件与长期建设不适合只求快攻

positive_indicators: 王庭政治提供可调整的制度路线
values.rationale: 边区重建与沼泽治理带来公共利益，吸血鬼宫廷政治及宗教统一路线造成约束与伤害风险；征服和君主制本身不作为邪恶证据。
red_flags: 吸血鬼阶层与宫廷权力纠葛
部分政治事件可能危及统治者和社会稳定
